why: Hands the page's HUD the raw flag instead of the resolved style, which is the pre-#922 wiring: the arena ring of an unflagged FFA match draws `shape` while the stock strip beside it draws no mark, splitting the pair #234 ruled on, and `solid` reaches the HUD as a style its icon function draws as a `shape` outline. Every injected HUD in the suite is built without this factory, so only the case that builds the page HUD through `createBrowserDeps` can see it.
killedBy: createBrowserDeps carries the parsed browser query state into GameDeps hands the page HUD the shipped FFA identity mark, and none for the reversal value (issue #922)
